name: BATA Link On-Demand
note: Two-county service area (Traverse City area and surrounding villages in Grand Traverse and Leelanau Counties).

name: BCGo
note: Calhoun County service area with primary operations in Battle Creek area.

name: Benzie Bus Dial-A-Ride
note: Countywide demand-response service based in Beulah.

name: Blugo (Clinton Transit)
note: Zone-based service with two distinct service zones; pickup and drop-off must be in same zone

name: CATA Rydz
note: Two on-demand zones, each a subset of its municipality, not full boundaries: Lansing zone bounded by Old Town (north), Mt Hope Hwy (south), Pennsylvania Ave (east), Waverly Rd south of St. Joseph Hwy (west); Delta Township zone bounded by I-496 (north), Millwood Hwy (south), Waverly Rd (east), Nixon Rd/Canal Rd (west). Late-night zone connects the two; airport service (CATA Rydz Connect) serves trips within these same two zones. Source: https://www.cata.org/services/cata-rydz

name: Charlevoix County Transit
note: Countywide demand-response service. Eligibility-restriction language not found; included based on countywide availability statement with no application requirement.

name: Clare County Transit Corporation
note: Countywide demand-response service covering Harrison, Clare, and surrounding townships

name: Crawford County Transportation Authority
note: Countywide demand-response service centered on Grayling; serves Frederic, Maple Forest, Beaver Creek, South Branch, Lovells

name: Gladwin City/County Transit
note: Countywide demand-response service covering City of Gladwin and surrounding townships

name: Go2 (Muskegon Area Transit)
note: Service area is Muskegon County with fixed-route hub connections.

name: I-DART (Ionia Dial-A-Ride)
note: City of Ionia with surrounding area; service zone is approximate, centered on the city

name: I-Ride (Isabella County Transportation Commission)
note: Countywide demand-response service with cross-county transfer options available

name: Iosco Transit Corporation
note: Countywide demand-response service along Lake Huron; covers East Tawas, Tawas City, Oscoda, and surrounding areas

name: Kalkaska Public Transit Authority
note: Countywide demand-response service with separate Village and countywide door-to-door services; connects to Traverse City

name: Manistee County Transportation
note: Countywide demand-response service along Lake Michigan; covers City of Manistee and surrounding townships

name: Metro Link (Kalamazoo Metro)
note: Three zones, not countywide: East zone covers Comstock Township, South zone covers Portage, West zone covers Oshtemo Township and parts of Texas Township. No exact zone boundaries or size published; townships shown here are approximate containing units, not full zone extent. Sources: https://www.wmuk.org/wmuk-news/2024-04-18/kalamazoo-metro-launches-a-rideshare-service, https://comstockmi.gov/2024/04/01/new-ridesharing-service-to-launch-in-comstock-charter-township/, https://city.ridewithvia.com/metrolink

name: MTA Genesee Connect
note: First zone (launching July 2026) is the Hill Rd. Corridor, a linear corridor, not full coverage of any of these units. MTA's own page says the zone is 'located in Flint and Grand Blanc' (city of Grand Blanc used here; township boundary is ambiguous in Census data and unresolvable from the source text); coverage of the ribbon-cutting event (at the Mundy Township Senior Center on Hill Rd) also names Mundy Township as a stop area. No zone size, radius, or boundary streets published; more zones planned. Sources: https://www.mtaflint.org/genesee-connect/, https://midmichigannow.com/news/local/mta-introduces-the-new-micro-transit-service-in-genesee-county

name: Ogemaw County Public Transportation
note: County-wide demand-response service

name: ROSCOTA
note: Roscommon County service for residents and visitors, with medical connections to neighboring/downstate counties.

name: SMART Flex
note: Zones in Dearborn, Troy/Clawson, Pontiac/Auburn Hills, Farmington/Farmington Hills, and Hall Road corridor (Utica-New Baltimore). Multiple zones across three counties with varying coverage; actual service area is subset of named counties.

name: Straits Regional Ride
note: Three-county service; supplemental dial-a-ride offered within City of Cheboygan and 5-mile radius

name: The Interurban
note: Service area covers Saugatuck city, Douglas city, and Saugatuck Township (Allegan County) per https://saugatuckinterurban.org/; the township is omitted from the mapped boundary because Census cousub data for Saugatuck Township collides on name with a pseudo-cousub for Saugatuck city, which the resolver cannot disambiguate — polygon shown here covers the two incorporated cities only.

name: TheRide FlexRide-East
note: Select areas of Ypsilanti Township, connecting to Ypsilanti Transit Center. Actual service is subset of city proxy.

name: Thunder Bay Transportation Authority
note: Service centered in City of Alpena with service extending to areas just outside city limits

name: WexExpress
note: Countywide service with regional connections to Tustin and Traverse City (neighboring areas).

name: Yates Township Transportation System
note: Service primarily spans Yates and adjacent townships; exact township list undefined (14+ townships mentioned)
